name: tubegpt
description: Chat with a YouTube video using its real transcript. Summaries and answers include timestamp links to the exact moment when the transcript has timing data.

interface.longDescription:
Ask questions about a YouTube video and get answers built from what is actually said in it. The skill reads the video's own captions, then summarizes, extracts key points or finds a specific moment, and, when the transcript has timing data, attaches timestamp links so you can jump straight to that second. Plain pasted text without timestamps cannot provide real timestamp links.

It works only from a real transcript. If captions cannot be read, it says so instead of guessing, and you can paste the transcript text or attach a caption file (.srt, .vtt, .txt) instead. Videos without captions cannot be read.

This is an independent skill and is not affiliated with or endorsed by YouTube or Google.
defaultPrompt: Summarize this YouTube video and link each point to its timestamp.
Find where the video explains the main idea and link me to that moment.
Turn this lecture video into study notes with timestamp links.
